observed_gap.description: The qualified loop had no committed recovery anchor before the first 50k checkpoint, and its base claim gate accepted only RESOURCE_PREFLIGHT_PASS, making explicit recovery after a crash impossible without a claim-state adapter.

repair.step0_anchor_purpose: Recovery only: commit full model/optimizer/EMA/RNG/sampler/cursor state before optimizer step 1 so any pre-50k execution tail can be discarded and replayed from a content-addressed state.
repair.resume_policy: Explicit resume only. The supplied checkpoint must be the claim's latest committed path and SHA; if another matching training process is alive on the same host, resume fails closed. Current claim state is preserved in resume_transition_from before transition to TRAINING_RUNNING.
